comment: Param 6, the small knob under the Boost label whose tooltip reads Drive CV, is never read by the code: the boost and cut CV input is applied at a fixed 20dB per volt. It is on the panel and can be clicked, so it is tagged to a line saying it does nothing. Params 4 and 5 (Dry and Wet) are configured but not placed on the panel. The Q line was corrected in this pass: Enable Self Oscilation sets the filter's damping term to zero whatever Q is set to, so the previous clause tying self oscillation to a Q of 20 was wrong.
